root_cause_hint: 车辆HV(高压部件)故障导致整车状态异常,疑似车辆条件不满足导致RSU无法搜包;尚未完成根因分析(backend/preanalysis被要求但未见结果)
recovery: 更换HV部件后复检RSU状态(未验证)

limitations: 闭环评论仅表明因车辆HV故障暂缓复检并关闭,无根因分析、无修复版本、无TIS 25-11-530与该票的明确关联证据;仅单台测试车(VIN:WBY71HY04SCV11340),客户现场适用性未知;backend/testbench预分析结果未在摘录中出现。

symptom_cn: 红色CCM报警后车辆断电，12V蓄电池断接后车辆永久无法启动，需拖车
symptom_en: Red CCM with gong while driving, then after power-off and 12V battery disconnect/reconnect the vehicle permanently fails to power on/start; tow required
trigger: 正常行驶中红CCM报警（PSP通信故障/PCU S2电压合理性故障），路边停车下电；尝试断开重接12V蓄电池后无法启动
function: 48V basic on-board network / Display Check-Control-Message and telltales
closure_quote: Neuer PQM Punkt erstellt: PP683651PCU48Gen 3 DTC 0x80890F Permanent HW-Failure G70 FIT. Since ticket now PQM, closing ticket.
root_cause_hint: PCU硬件缺陷（疑似过流/过压事件，S2电压stuck-close），DTC 0x80890F永久性HW故障
service_hint: 确认DTC 0x80890F存在且PCU复位后仍保留时，判定为PCU硬件永久失效，直接更换PCU并关联PQM点PP683651PCU48Gen3索赔。
limitations: 硬件分析结果（供应商端）未见回填；DTC根因为单一HW事件，尚无最终供应商分析报告佐证；票因PQM转交关闭，后续修复措施无法在本票追溯。

symptom_cn: 询问'有什么好玩的地方'时语音助手回复'MPP已卸载，请尝试其他应用'，无法跳转导航推荐POI

limitations: 关闭时评论显示原计划11/30发布并12月复测，但未见复测通过证据；供应商'by design'结论与测试员'Cannot accept it as spec'存在冲突；最终修复版本落地情况未在摘录中确认。

symptom_cn: 蓝牙音频全屏播放界面切歌时，歌词/歌曲名区域文本与新的元数据文字重叠闪烁

closure_quote: 23.01.2026, ExpertTeam: tolerate ok ... • Tolerate purposed • Error Description: While updating the lyrics in the BT fullscreen, the text will overlaps with the new metadata • Customer impact: No Customer impact.
root_cause_hint: MediaApp在蓝牙音频元数据快速变化时未及时刷新FullScreenPlayer UI的歌曲标题/歌词区域，导致新旧文本重叠（Sherlog日志分析指向MediaApp，Team Hummingbirds）
fix_or_target: none（tolerate关闭；曾Request TIS 26-07-480但最终以容忍流程关闭）
recovery: 无法恢复（界面上直到下次元数据刷新）

limitations: tolerate理由'No Customer impact'与原始描述'Customer complaints'存在矛盾；根因仅有AI日志分析（MediaApp刷新时序），无最终工程根因确认；无testcase参考；切歌自然刷新后是否自动恢复无明确证据。

limitations: Traces仅在BBA内网无法外部核验；本票为重复票，根因与修复验证详情在master票D2245581中；仅在单台NA6 FIT试验车(1B36283)上报告，量产现场发生率未知。

symptom_cn: 数字钥匙配对失败,车机提示'激活移动设备错误,请重试',手机端提示'无法添加数字钥匙',iPhone和华为均报同样错误

symptom_cn: 直流充电且SOC超过80%时，在CID上调整目标SOC后，充电PHUD上的续航里程(E-range)不随之更新
symptom_en: During DC charging with SOC over 80%, e-range on charging PHUD does not adjust when target SOC is changed on CID
trigger: 1. Vehicle DC charging 2. My vehicle -> charging 3. Change target SOC on CID 4. Observe e-range on CID vs PHUD (occurs when displayStateOfChargeHvs < soeIntermediateChargingTarget, SOC threshold ~80%)
function: Instrument Cluster - Charging Range Prediction Display (PHUD ElectricRangeIntermediateSoe)
closure_quote: EADM: Topic is a duplicate to Defect 2320222 - Estimated Range does not add up with Charging Prognosis (2% equals 100km?) / Close as dup. Follow master ticket.
root_cause_hint: 供应商分析:当displayStateOfChargeHvs(15) < soeIntermediateChargingTarget(80)时按MD需求显示ElectricRangeIntermediateSoe;CID显示RangePredictionChargingTarget而PHUD显示IntermediateSoe/ChargingErouteTarget，两者信号/逻辑不一致
service_hint: 向客户解释为显示逻辑不一致(已知问题2320222)，续航预测值不影响实际充电功能，等待主票软件修复。

symptom_cn: 车辆多次黄屏重启后用户配置文件丢失，无法直接登录个人配置文件；锁车休眠约5分钟后自动恢复可登录。
symptom_en: After multiple yellow screen resets, the user profile is lost and direct login fails; it auto-recovers after the car sleeps for ~5 minutes.
trigger: 车辆多次黄屏重启 -> profile丢失 -> 尝试登录profile失败；ICON与IDCE会话状态不同步(ACCOUNT_HAS_SESSION)
closure_quote: dupl to Defect 2313245 ... Issue is the same as IDCEVODEV-536332, will be fixed in IDCEVODEV-544564. Integrated in 'common-mainline/bundle/idcevo/rse26-mainline/25w29.2-1' ... Master fixed

trigger: 实车正常测试 → 打开BMW应用商店检查应用状态 → 点击咪咕(Migu)应用的更新按钮;根因链:已安装版本1.1.26与新版本1.1.28签名不一致,系统PackageManager拒绝覆盖安装('signatures do not match newer version; ignoring')
function: Manage BMW Apps / In-Car-App-Store app update
closure_quote: Aligned with PF, this info had already been shared... Signature is changed, need to uninstall Migu first then install the 1.1.28 version. So we can only reject this ticket or dup it to 2373527.
root_cause_hint: 新旧版本APK签名不一致导致包管理器拒绝升级,已知规避方案为先卸载旧版(1.1.26)再安装1.1.28
recovery: 先卸载咪咕应用再重新安装1.1.28版本(或IDCevo工厂复位)
service_hint: 若客户反馈咪咕应用更新失败,指导客户先卸载咪咕应用后再从应用商店重新安装新版(签名变更所致),无需更换硬件。
limitations: 证据仅来自测试车辆(NA6 iX3, IDCEVO25)与日志分析;客户现场是否受影响取决于量产车是否预装旧签名1.1.26版本;母票2373527内容不可见,修复版本与发布状态未知。

symptom_cn: 行车中语音拨号时，语音助手回复“抱歉，我没找到任何联系人”，重试后可成功

trigger: 1) Vehicle driving; 2) Vivo X90 connected via in-car BT; 3) NetEase cloud music playing; speech call command issued while phone book contact update still in progress (contactStatus isUpdating=true, listSize=0)
function: CN Speech - voice call / contact lookup
closure_quote: Seit 6-Wochen hat keine Bearbeitung des Defects stattgefunden, deswegen wird der Defect mit der Phase "CWA" geschlossen. Bei erneutem Auftreten, mit neuer Software, ein neuen Defect erstellen.
root_cause_hint: 电话簿联系人同步更新期间(listSize=0)语音拨号命令被执行，系统在空联系人列表中查找导致TTS报错；第二次命令时联系人已更新完成(1537条)故成功
recovery: 重试语音命令(联系人同步完成后成功)

symptom_cn: 语音说"关闭CarPlay"，结果蓝牙被关闭而非CarPlay
symptom_en: Speech command 'Turn off CarPlay' turns off Bluetooth instead of CarPlay
trigger: 车辆静止 + iPhone 13 Pro Max(iOS18.6)连接CarPlay + 语音说'断开/关闭CarPlay'，语音助手将module=carplay的disconnect意图映射为蓝牙断开
closure_quote: Seit 6-Wochen hat keine Bearbeitung des Defects stattgefunden, deswegen wird der Defect mit der Phase "CWA" geschlossen. Bei erneutem Auftreten, mit neuer Software, ein neuen Defect erstellen.

service_hint: 向客户解释为语音指令词典限制，建议手动操作或改用其他措辞，蓝牙可手动重新开启。
limitations: 关闭原因为超时流程关闭(CWA)而非工程修复确认；供应商称by design但未见正式需求/规格文档佐证；fvv双重确认(Comment 4)无后续结果记录；2LC可复现但无客户现场投诉数据。

symptom_cn: CarPlay连接iPhone 15 Pro Max时,来电导致CarPlay突然崩溃/断开,无法恢复
symptom_en: CarPlay suddenly crashes/disconnects when receiving an incoming call and cannot recover

closure_quote: Identified child/duplicate of Defect 2385578... Issue is similar to IDCEVODEV-639221 duplicate

limitations: 标记为duplicate但master 2385578标题为'SMS readout'与症状不完全一致;无修复版本信息;原票描述与supplier根因指向audio focus冲突,重复关联准确性存疑;审计风险分11提示重复关联可能不当。

symptom_cn: 媒体选择器中的收音机(Radio)图标显示一条黑线
symptom_en: Radio icon in the Media selector displays a black line
trigger: 在车机中央显示屏切换/查看媒体源选择器时，Radio图标出现黑线（评论提及切换回FM时出现，切换多媒体音源后恢复）
function: Media Source Selector / Radio Icon Display (Listen to Radio, Display Settings CID)
closure_quote: this is a duplicate of https://jira.cc.bmwgroup.net/browse/IDCEVODEV-531232. Closing this issue.
root_cause_hint: 图标渲染/UI toolkit资源显示异常，疑似与IDCEVODEV-531232（黑条图标类问题）同根因
recovery: 手动（再次切换多媒体音源后图标恢复正常）
service_hint: 告知客户切换媒体音源即可恢复图标显示，属已知图标显示缺陷已关联主票跟踪，暂无需换件。
limitations: 本票无独立原始描述与触发条件槽位，恢复/复现信息仅来自AI对相似票的总结；master票IDCEVODEV-531232的实际修复状态与根因在本票评论中不可见。

symptom_cn: 行驶中通过iPhone播放蓝牙音频时无法进入蓝牙音频详情界面，主页多媒体小组件和PHUD也无法获取歌曲信息，下次LC后自动恢复
symptom_en: While driving and playing Bluetooth audio from iPhone, cannot enter Bluetooth audio detail interface; home multimedia widget and PHUD cannot obtain song info; recovered at next lifecycle
trigger: Driving mode + Bluetooth audio playback (iPhone 14 Pro Max, iOS 18.7.1); frequency ~1/5 in DR statistics, multiple occurrences per week
closure_quote: duplicate of 2433404/IDCEVODEV-683735; master ticket Closed in ver.: release/idcevo/idcevo-pu2511_i530/25w42.3-2
root_cause_hint: getActiveSource not updated - active source state not refreshed, causing media source/song info unavailable (log: ActiveSourceName empty)
fix_or_target: master票已在25w42.3-2版本关闭，修复见master 2433404/IDCEVODEV-683735
service_hint: 如客户反馈蓝牙音频无法进入详情/歌曲信息缺失，建议引导重启车机或等待下次LC，该问题已随25w42.3-2修复版本解决。
limitations: 本票为重复关联关闭，修复验证细节在master票内本票不可见；trace数据在BBA内网无法交叉核验；复现率约1/5为临时统计，样本有限；无独立复测确认本票症状在修复版本中消除。

symptom_cn: 系统语言为英文时,BMT后座屏显示菜单第一行文字显示不完整/被截断

trigger: 进入显示菜单 > 选择设置菜单 > 系统语言设为英文
function: MMI / Rear Theatre Screen (BMTH) Display Settings Menu
closure_quote: Issue duplicate to Defect 2464195 - BMT: Text in Theatre Screen display settings cut off ====>Rejected as duplicate
root_cause_hint: 英文语言下文本布局/换行截断,疑似翻译文本长度超出UI控件区域
recovery: 切换系统语言(非英文)可能规避,未验证
service_hint: 属显示文本截断的界面瑕疵,不影响功能,告知客户将随主缺陷2464195修复,暂可通过调整系统语言规避。
limitations: 重复票关闭,依赖master票2464195的分析结果,本票内无根因/修复版本证据;master票内容不可见(BBA侧曾无法搜索到该票);复现率未记录。

symptom_cn: 在BMTH上调节低音和高音后，CID上无法将均衡器恢复默认值；需先在CID上修改一次再重置才能恢复默认。
symptom_en: Equalizer cannot be reset to default on CID after bass/treble were set on BMTH; reset works only after changing a setting on CID first.
trigger: enter audio menu on BMTH > set bass and treble to lowest on BMTH > open equalizer menu on CID > press reset on CID
closure_quote: This is an exact duplicate of IDCEVODEV-789361. Closing as duplicate with the master ticket of IDCEVODEV-789361 (which is IDCEVODEV-774218).
root_cause_hint: reset路径因前置操作来源(BMTH vs CID)不同：仅CID侧调整的设置经AudiosSettingsRepository转发功放，BMTH侧设置的项未被reset流程覆盖
recovery: 在CID上先手动修改一次设置，再点击reset即可恢复默认值
service_hint: 告知客户先在CID上改动任一音效设置后再执行重置即可恢复默认值，属已知重复缺陷、待主票修复。
limitations: master票修复状态与目标版本未知；复现率未知(标注'occurs in multiple lifecycles: yes'但无率数据)；trace在BBA内网不可外部核实。

symptom_cn: 钉钉通话结束后整车音频仍被通话占用，全车无声，需再次发起钉钉通话才能恢复
symptom_en: After ending a Dingtalk call, whole vehicle audio remains occupied by phone call; recovery requires making another Dingtalk call
trigger: 钉钉(Dingtalk)通话结束 -> Karaoke(QMKTV)申请audio focus被HU拒绝(EvLoss)，音频通道未释放
closure_quote: Dup to IDCEVODEV-781924 2513018 ... Whole vehicle audio lose, need to recover with new LC
root_cause_hint: Dingtalk释放audio focus并结束通话后，QMKTV请求焦点虽被MediaFocusControl授予，但HU侧拒绝焦点(EvLoss)，导致音频通道悬挂
recovery: 再次发起并结束一次钉钉通话
service_hint: 遇客户投诉全车无声时，引导再次发起并结束一次钉钉通话即可恢复，无需换件；跟踪master票修复版本。
limitations: 重复票自身无独立复现率与修复版本信息，恢复手段仅来自PF描述，master票修复状态未在本票证据中体现

symptom_cn: 行驶中所有屏幕黑屏约2秒,快速自动恢复,持续行驶后可能再次发生
symptom_en: All screens black about 2s during driving; quick auto recovery but may recur during continued driving
trigger: 正常行驶(Fahren),无特殊条件;日志显示MCU检测到SFI timeout导致OOB关闭,DisplayControlState变为NOT_ALLOWED,所有显示链路down
closure_quote: Master ticket is concluded. The same issue is not reproduced on recent software. CWA this one. Duplicate to: IDCEVODEV-787222 • Octane: 2517669
root_cause_hint: MCU检测到SFI超时触发OOB下电(安全机制),DisplayControlState NOT_ALLOWED,所有显示链路掉线,疑与IDCEVODEV-787222/745937相关
fix_or_target: TIS软件已刷入FIT车验证,近期软件未复现;修复随master ticket IDCEVODEV-787222落地
recovery: 自动恢复(约2秒),但持续行驶可能复发
service_hint: 如客户反馈行驶中短暂全屏黑屏,先确认车机软件为最新(TIS之后版本),收集时间段日志核对OOB/SFI timeout事件,旧软件可建议升级。
limitations: 关闭依据为master票结论+近期软件未复现,本票无独立复测记录;发生多车多生命周期但概率低;根因细节在master票内不可见;customer现场实际软件版本分布未知。

symptom_cn: 语音说'添加到收藏'时命令识别成功，但IPA偶发(1次路试中2次)回复'当前没有正在播放的内容'
symptom_en: Speech command 'add to favorite' recognized correctly but IPA sporadically replies 'there is no currently content played' (2 times in 1 LC)
trigger: QQ音乐为音源行驶中，'Hello MINI'唤醒并说'添加到收藏'；日志显示当时QQ音乐及导航相关HTTP请求SocketTimeout、MQTT连接断开，疑似网络异常诱发
function: CN Speech / In-Car Assistant (IPA) - QQ Music voice interaction
closure_quote: wave app trace auto delete, so current close ticket, and will retest with another car.
root_cause_hint: 网络相关：日志显示HTTP请求SocketTimeout超时及MQTT连接断开，可能导致IPA无法获取当前播放内容状态
recovery: 切换音源到收音机后切回QQ音乐
service_hint: 如客户反馈语音'添加收藏'提示无播放内容，建议切换音源(收音机)后切回QQ音乐即可恢复，属偶发网络超时所致。
limitations: wave trace自动删除导致无法深挖根因；仅1次路试2次偶发，未在它车复测；关闭原因为证据丢失而非修复，缺master票与target版本信息

symptom_cn: 右侧迎宾光毯无法点亮，报DTC 0x804085 (DYN_LT_R) LIN-Slave丢失，e-fuse ID 1002状态显示未激活/未编码
symptom_en: Right side carpet light cannot be activated; DTC 0x804085 (DYN_LT_R) Missing LIN-Slave; e-fuse ID 1002 shows not coded/not activated
trigger: NA6 FIT车1B36283, I-level NA06-26-03-440, 装载旧版IPB HW (013.000.004, HW D0.5.8以下)，eFuse DlpLal在该HW变体上报告为not assembled，导致eFuseSlave无法激活
function: Power path management / e-fuse control for right dynamic carpet light (DYN_LT_R)
closure_quote: The issue solved: 1. IPB (V03) HWEL: D058-013.000.008 with I-Step 26-03-460 2. IPB max variant (V05) with software >= 25-07-480 Close the ticket
root_cause_hint: 旧版IPB硬件(013.000.004, D0.5.8前)DlpLal eFuse被配置为upgrade L4且报告not assembled，eFuse编码/IPBD-96954相关，旧件不在SOP使用范围
fix_or_target: IPB (V03) HWEL D058-013.000.008 with I-Step 26-03-460; IPB max variant (V05) software >= 25-07-480
recovery: 更换新版IPB硬件或更新软件至修复版本
service_hint: 若客户车辆出现右侧光毯不亮+DTC 0x804085，检查IPB硬件版本及eFuse编码状态，需更换/升级至已修复的IPB版本(V03 D058-013.000.008以上或V05软件>=25-07-480)。
limitations: 复现性未知；Comment 1为空无内容；标签关闭原因为PQM Transfer但评论显示问题已解决关闭，以评论为准；仅单车FIT试验车验证，多个生命周期出现但平台单一；Final验证结果评论未明确附复测证据。

symptom_cn: 后排唤醒语音助手(IPA)后，IPA不仅接收并显示后排语音，还同时接收并显示驾驶员说的话
symptom_en: After rear row wake-up of IPA, the IPA receives and displays not only rear row words but also driver words
trigger: 静态状态下Personal Assistant开启，Just talk开启，所有语音识别区域激活；左后乘员唤醒IPA后驾驶员说非指令词，驾驶员语音也被识别并显示
function: CN Speech (In-Car Personal Assistant voice recognition zone isolation)
closure_quote: Defect cwa geschlossen, da seit mindestens 4 Wochen keine Bearbeitung. (FollowUp leer oder abgelaufen); 供应商曾称'rear right microphone is faulty'但日志与视频始终不匹配，未确认复测
root_cause_hint: 供应商曾指向右后麦克风硬件故障，但因日志/视频时间不匹配无法完成分析验证，根因未确认
recovery: 整车休眠后下一LC仍无法恢复
service_hint: 若客户投诉多区域语音串扰，先检查后排麦克风硬件状态并采集时间匹配的日志/视频后再提票，无现成软件修复方案。
limitations: 供应商质疑日志与视频时间范围不匹配，ASR相关日志缺失，无法证实或证伪缺陷；曾关闭为'未复现'后因PO要求重开，最终因CWA流程规则关闭，缺工程根因证据。

symptom_cn: 系统语言为中文时,DPM(数据隐私菜单)中“位置访问”条目未翻译
symptom_en: Location access item in DPM is not translated when system language is Chinese
trigger: 系统语言切换为中文 → 打开数据隐私菜单(DPM) → 检查“Location access”条目显示英文未翻译
function: Privacy Manager / Data Privacy Menu localization
closure_quote: Expected, the translation will be first available in v1.69.0 of the data privacy menu.
root_cause_hint: privacy-manager DPM 翻译资源滞后,中文语言包在 v1.69.0 才提供
fix_or_target: privacy-manager data privacy menu v1.69.0(评论3更正为 v10.69.0,存在版本号不一致)
recovery: 切换系统语言为已翻译语言(如英语)|none
service_hint: 向客户解释中文翻译将在后续privacy-manager版本(v1.69.0/v10.69.0)提供,暂无硬件或功能故障,无需维修。
limitations: 评论中目标版本自相矛盾(Comment3称v10.69.0,Comment4称v1.69.0),未确认修复实际落地版本;该票后被BR(Blocking Reason)流程拒绝,后续处理状态未知;无修复验证/复测记录;trace数据不可访问。

symptom_cn: 行车中尝试激活沉浸式导航时，导航有时无法进入LLN，且CID右下角无切换导航模式图标
symptom_en: Navigation sometimes fails to enter LLN and no icon appears in lower right corner of CID to switch navigation modes when activating immersive navigation while driving
trigger: 车辆在INT环境联网行驶，行车中激活沉浸式导航（部分LC可复现）
closure_quote: Feature not planned for 26-03. HMI setting will be removed in next official Navi APP.
root_cause_hint: 功能未在此版本规划实现，HMI入口计划移除
fix_or_target: HMI setting将在下一版正式Navi APP中移除（无明确版本号）
service_hint: 客户反馈时建议重启系统恢复，并说明该HMI入口将在后续Navi APP版本中移除
limitations: 评论仅说明功能未规划及HMI移除计划，未提供根因分析、目标版本号或master票链接；trace数据存于BBA内网无法核查；是否已在量产客户车上出现unknown

symptom_cn: 在ConnectedDrive商店更新应用时升级失败，弹出“发生错误”提示
symptom_en: APPS upgrade failed in ConnectedDrive Store with an error popup
trigger: Customer updates apps in ConnectedDrive Store (App Store v3.32.0); log shows Faurecia authentication initial request failed, invalidated token causing retry with new token
function: Personalization / App Store Application Upgrade (ConnectedDrive Store APPS update)
closure_quote: Since this defect has outdated SW and many improvements were made in the meantime, please perform a retest with recent SW... 20250617 test ok ICON__25__P_25W23_3_1.025_040_009.pdx
root_cause_hint: Authentication token invalidation during App Store request (FaureciaAuthenticationInterceptor initial request failed, token invalidated, retry with new token failed)
fix_or_target: Retest OK on ICON 25__P_25W23_3_1.025_040_009.pdx (improvements in newer SW)
recovery: Retry app update (re-authentication with new token may succeed); token refresh behavior uncertain
service_hint: 建议引导客户重试APP更新并确认登录账户/token刷新正常，若在新软件版本上复现请重新提票并附新trace。
limitations: 关闭标签为'功能未实现/不可测试'与评论证据（过时SW+复测通过）冲突；复测仅为一次通过、无正式修复版本号或根因正式结论；trace仅在BBA内网，无法独立验证。

symptom_cn: PAD模式下进入驾驶设置,点击"配置驾驶模式"后按返回键能回到驾驶设置;但点击"驾驶声浪"后再按返回键,UI直接跳回主页面而非返回驾驶设置页
symptom_en: In Drive Settings, back button from 'drive sound' page returns to main launcher instead of Drive Settings, inconsistent with back behavior from 'configure driving mode' page
trigger: PAD mode on → enter drive settings → click 'drive sound' → press back button
function: MMI / Drive Settings navigation (back button logic)
closure_quote: Works as expected. If jumped to completely new app the back button belongs to the app and will close this app with result that it jumps back to the cardomain. If jumped to different position in the cardomain the back button belongs to cardomain.
root_cause_hint: 返回键归属逻辑按目标应用域(cardomain vs 独立app)划分,drive sound被视为独立app,跳转即退出cardomain返回launcher
recovery: 重新进入drive settings即可|无需
service_hint: 向客户解释该返回逻辑为系统设计(跨应用返回至主界面),可通过重新进入设置菜单规避,无需维修。
limitations: 关闭依据仅为供应商口头'Works as expected',未见正式设计规格文档或产品决策记录;原始描述中的恢复措施'next lc'含义不明;无master票或跨系统key证据。

symptom_cn: 在华为应用商店安装/卸载应用时,音乐播放(QQ音乐等)出现约0.7-1.0秒的卡顿/中断,收音机播放正常
symptom_en: Music playback (e.g. QQ Music) intermittently stutters/interrupts (~0.7-1.0s gaps) while installing/uninstalling apps in Huawei store; Radio unaffected
trigger: PAD mode + 播放QQ音乐/音乐流 -> 进入华为应用商店 -> 安装或卸载应用 -> 系统负载导致IRQ延迟(34.2ms vs 期望1.3ms) -> PCM buffer饥饿 -> 音频设备stop/restart
closure_quote: please note that there was a false linkage in this defect due to a false setting in the actual master. The actual master 2396388 is not fixed yet!
root_cause_hint: 应用安装/卸载引发CPU负载导致音频IRQ延迟34ms,PCM buffer饥饿自动stop;另一次无IRQ异常,疑AudioHAL层主动stop,待PERF与CTW进一步分析
recovery: 安装/卸载完成后音乐自动恢复播放(设备restart),无需用户操作
service_hint: 属已知master票2396388未修复问题,向客户解释应用安装期间短暂音频中断为临时现象,完成后自动恢复,无需更换硬件。
limitations: 主票2396388尚未修复,本票关闭依据为错误关联设置;复现率未知(复测数据缺失);根因仍需PERF/CTW团队perf trace确认,AudioHAL层主动stop的第二次发生机制未定。

symptom_cn: 车辆行驶状态下激活/关闭ANC(主动降噪)时,车内无可感知的降噪差异
symptom_en: No perceptible difference in cabin noise when activating/deactivating ANC while vehicle is in dynamic status
trigger: 车辆处于行驶状态 -> 在音频设置中切换ANC激活/关闭 -> 每个生命周期(LC)均可复现
function: ANC (Active Noise Cancellation) in Audio Settings
closure_quote: Defect has been rejected because a Blocking Reason (BR) is set (according to the official DM process)... Function not tuned yet. Please wait for series tuning for evaluating this (post I-490)... we'll retest this ticket when FUD is arrived, close this ticket now
root_cause_hint: ANC功能尚未完成量产调音(series tuning post I-490),非软件缺陷本身,需等待FUD后调音完成再评估
